channel.title: From the blog
channel.description: Learnings, recommendations & new features from ServiceStack engineers

item.title: Follow every request with OpenTelemetry
item.author: demis@servicestack.com (Demis)
item.description: ServiceStack v10.3 emits standard OpenTelemetry traces and metrics that follow a request from its API call through outbound HTTP calls, MQ messages and Background Jobs, even across servers, in Jaeger, Grafana Tempo, Honeycomb, Datadog or the .NET Aspire Dashboard

item.title: API Rate Limiting
item.author: demis@servicestack.com (Demis)
item.description: ServiceStack v10.3 adds opt-in ASP.NET Core rate limiting for ServiceStack APIs - bind a named policy to a Request DTO or share one budget across every API with the same Tag, enforced across every route an API can be called from

item.title: Software Licensing Next.js Project Template
item.author: demis@servicestack.com (Demis)
item.description: Next License is a new .NET 10, ServiceStack and Next.js 16 template for selling perpetual, offline-verified JWT licenses for your .NET and Electron desktop apps, with Stripe Checkout, GitHub-hosted downloads and an Operations Center, and no activation server to run

item.title: SaaS Next.js Project Template
item.author: demis@servicestack.com (Demis)
item.description: Next SaaS is a new production-ready .NET 10, ServiceStack and Next.js 16 template for multi-tenant B2C and B2B SaaS products, with organizations, Stripe subscriptions, versioned plans, usage quotas and an Operations Center included from day one

item.title: Scalable Background Jobs
item.author: demis@servicestack.com (Demis)
item.description: ServiceStack v10.3 turns Background Jobs into a durable job platform - scale out across App Servers, queues with runtime controls, exactly-once guarantees, workflows, batches and production-grade schedules, all on the database you already run

item.title: Startup Tasks - Generate code from your running App
item.author: demis@servicestack.com (Demis)
item.description: StartupTasks run dev-time tasks once your App has fully started, keeping client DTOs and other generated code in sync with your server on every restart, with no extra build step for developers or AI Assistants to remember

item.title: OrmLite gets type-safe JSON access and Upserts
item.author: demis@servicestack.com (Demis)
item.description: Query JSON columns with typed C# expressions that run unchanged on SQLite, PostgreSQL, SQL Server and MySQL, and insert-or-update rows in a single native statement with the new Upsert APIs

item.title: Hardened ServiceStack - A Codebase-Wide Security & Reliability Audit
item.author: demis@servicestack.com (Demis)
item.description: ServiceStack v10.2 ships the results of an AI-assisted security and reliability audit across 36 packages, with every fix published for review - your Apps get safer defaults just by upgrading

item.title: Gemini RAG - AI Answers Customers can Verify from your Content
item.author: demis@servicestack.com (Demis)
item.description: Turn the files, docs and websites you already maintain into managed knowledge bases, then publish a citation-backed AI Assistant and instant, model-free Website Search to any site with one script tag

item.title: ServiceStack PDF Studio — From AI Design to Production PDFs
item.author: demis@servicestack.com (Demis)
item.description: Design Typst PDFs with AI Chat, publish validated templates, generate typed C# models and render production documents from your ServiceStack APIs
